## Iceberg statement

You do not have a time problem, you have a systems problem. The work that feels
like it has to be you almost never does. You can build the system once and the
business stops depending on you being in the room. Most service owners try to
fix overwhelm by working more hours. That makes the business heavier, not
bigger. The real move is to take the work out of your head and put it into a
system someone else can run.

## Content pillars

- **systems** (build the thing that does the work for you)
- **delegation** (get it out of your head and off your plate)
- **pricing** (charge what the outcome is worth, stop trading time for money)
- **mindset** (the identity shift from operator to owner)
